title: Ministries 4 of 4: Life Groups
question: Sunday 9:00 classes. People see what's on now, what's next and the all-year groups; nobody sees the word 'round'. Staff set up each new set of groups (its Sundays, time, rooms, groups, join as a parent) in the admin panel, not the app. Which should I build?

options.label: The round as a timetable
options.lineage: the printed Life Groups flyer as a grid
options.thesis: What's on now as a timetable: groups down, Sundays across, a dot per class.
materials: staff set-up: Now on and Next side by side
options.viewport: App: Now on (15 Nov to 6 Dec) as a grid with one changed and one off class, all-year groups with Join as a parent, a 'Next, from 24 January' card; a group with a Sundays tab. Admin: Now on and Next as two columns, Plan the next groups.
options.risk: The grid gets tight past six Sundays on a phone.

options.label: Choose one, page by page
options.thesis: 'Choose a group' opens a sheet, one group per page, when new groups are coming.
options.viewport: App: 'New groups from 24 January' with Choose a group, Now on and All year lists; a paged sheet per group with Join. Admin: Next groups as rows (Sundays, time, groups, shows from).
options.risk: After choosing, the Sundays aren't at a glance.

options.label: On the map
options.lineage: the church's site map by the door
options.thesis: The site map with each group's room pinned.
options.viewport: App: the site map with the Library and Room 2 pinned, groups listed under it; a group page with this Sunday's change. Admin: staff give rooms to groups on the map.
options.risk: The site map isn't built yet, so this is the most work.
